name: release-agent-amendment-decision
body:
The optional release-agent fills the slot the removed optional coordinator vacated.

Behaviour: the agent-builder scaffolds a per-repo release-agent, and the codebase-navigator dispatches it through the task tool after explicit user consent. The release-agent carries the release-adjacent git operations (git tag and git push, branch and tags) plus repo-specific release-artefact writes, interviewed per repo like the build gates. Its push/tag grant is ask: each push and tag command prompts for human approval. It is the only generated agent granted push/tag; every other generated agent gets deny-by-default.

Shape: mode subagent, hidden, generated; it routes questions through the coordinator and returns ACTIONED/WONT-FIX claims like every generated agent.

Spine: requirements.stakeholder.agent-suite-maintainer contains requirements.requirement.agent-builder-optional-release-agent (feature agent-builder-roster-cleanup); domain.entity.release-agent-flow (kind entity) is a child of domain.group.agent-roster, alongside generated-agent-set, distributed-agent-set, and agent-file-migration; requirements.constraint.push-tag-release-agent-carve-out is the scoped statement of the push/tag law. Edges: stakeholder ⊃ requirement —drives→ entity —realised-by→ the three reused components —implemented-by→ opencode-suite/agents/agent-builder.md, opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md, README.md, AGENTS.md.

The three edited surfaces resolve as real docs File nodes (opencode-suite/agents/agent-builder.md, opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md, AGENTS.md), so the implemented-by targets resolve and this change-set declares zero planned Implementation nodes for them.

solution.constraint.agent-builder-roster-truthful admits the optional release-agent (mode subagent, hidden, generated), names its push/tag ask carve-out, and keeps the coordinator/reviewer prohibitions. The release-agent's grant is ask; it is the only generated agent granted push/tag, every other generated agent gets deny-by-default, and the law's name is push/tag remain human-approved acts.

Component reuse: solution.component.agent-builder-prompt, solution.component.codebase-navigator-prompt, and solution.component.agent-roster-docs are already implemented-by exactly the files this change-set edits; agent-roster-docs is implemented-by AGENTS.md and README.md. All three are in scope via domain.entity.distributed-agent-set.

Scope: the change-set edits three docs/product-source surfaces. It edits zero files under .opencode/agents/** (consumer artifacts) and adds zero tests. scripts/release.sh pushes nothing, and the binary reaches git through git2, with the git CLI unused.
